source.title: Source tracks
source.unknown: The source's tracks are not known: the file is not open in this window, or it changed after it was probed.
source.noAudio: The source has no audio tracks.
source.noSubtitles: The source has no subtitle tracks.
source.name: Name
source.details: Track {n}: show or hide the details

bitrateHelp.statsTag: From the Matroska statistics tags (BPS, or NUMBER_OF_BYTES over DURATION)
bitrateHelp.unknown: Unknown: the stream, the statistics tags and MediaInfo do not give it

eventsFrom.unknown: Unknown: the file has no NUMBER_OF_FRAMES tag

output.title: Output tracks
output.addAllHelp: Adds an output track for every source track that has none yet
output.reloadHelp: Replaces these tracks with what the preset's rules choose for this source (Undo brings them back)
output.reloadGroup: Reload from preset rules is not available in a group: Defaults… and Apply to the group give the group's tracks back to the defaults.
output.fileScope: Edits go to this file only: tracks are added, removed and moved for the whole group. To use another source track or none in this file, pick it in the matrix (Check group).
output.fileScopeHelp: Tracks are added for the whole group: set Edits go to Group, or pick another track for this file in the matrix
output.noAudio: No audio tracks: the output will have no audio.
output.fallbackHelp: Passthru copies the track as it is. When the container cannot hold its codec, the track is encoded with this encoder instead.
output.copied: Passthru: the {codec} track is copied as it is, so the encoder settings do not apply.
output.drcHelp: Dynamic range compression of AC-3 and E-AC-3 sources when they are decoded: 0 is off, up to 4. Other sources are not changed.
output.forcedOnlyHelp: Burns in only the events marked forced. Only PGS and VobSub subtitles mark them.
output.convertedOnCopy: {container} cannot hold {codec} subtitles: they are converted to {format}.
output.rowFileScope: Edits go to this file only: tracks are moved and removed for the whole group. To use another source track or none in this file, pick it in the matrix (Check group).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.name: Name
metadata.nameNoSuggestions: This track has no values to make a name from
metadata.burned: A burned-in subtitle is part of the picture: it has no track, so its metadata is not written.

bulk.title: Edit {count} track | Edit {count} tracks
bulk.intro: Only what you change here is set; everything else stays as each track has it.

external.addHelp: Adds SRT, ASS, SSA, WebVTT or PGS (.sup) files as subtitle tracks
external.addGroup: Add external subtitle… is not available in a group: an external subtitle file belongs to one file. Close the group and open that file to add one.
external.unreadable: The file could not be read: its format and encoding are not known.
external.offsetHelp: Moves every event later (positive) or earlier (negative), in milliseconds.
external.charsetHelp: The encoding the file was saved in. UTF-8 needs none; FFmpeg cannot decode the text of any other file without it.
external.charsetBitmap: A bitmap file has no character encoding.
